newsitem.title: GERMANY: Debis aims to lift 97 sales to 15 bln DM.
newsitem.headline: Debis aims to lift 97 sales to 15 bln DM.

text.p: The Debis financial and telecommunications services unit of car maker Daimler-Benz AG said on Thursday it was aiming to lift 1997 revenue 14.5 percent to 15 billion marks, based on a 25 percent rise in the first five months of the year.
Profit was also showing promising development, a spokesman said.

Previously, the unit had expected 1997 revenue of about 14.1 billion marks. Earlier on Thursday Debis said it expected to recover its entire 1.3 billion mark investment in French software maker Cap Gemini by selling its 24.4 percent stake.
In 1996, Debis had sales of 13.1 billion marks and operating profit of 328 million marks.
